end.summary:
Practised showing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and some loose ones across 9 attempts.
One unaided response was correct: “Thirteen?”
Saanvi repeatedly counted the bundle as 1 when finding the total, including 4 for one bundle and three loose sticks and 7 for one bundle and six loose items.
The bundle-counting mix-up was still present at the last response; this skill needs checking again next time.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and loose ones. They often counted the bundle as 1 item instead of 10, and this was still happening in the final response; the idea needs more practice. At home, show one group of 10 objects and a few single objects, then ask, “How many altogether?” while counting the group as ten.
